evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-05-01, caught up with Calvin ("long time no see") and announced that he had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — a dream come true and a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars; shared a photo of the shop (including a group of people in front of a car) and of the engine of the classic car he restored in 2022, and invited Calvin to come by; Calvin congratulated him, the conversation closed with mutual encouragement, and Calvin shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S4T1][S4T5][S4T7][S4T15][S4T16][S4T17][S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-01, complimented Calvin's necklace and asked where he got it (Calvin: a gift from another artist, a reminder of why he keeps hustling as a musician); encouraged Calvin to keep pushing and making music, and the two agreed to keep each other motivated — "the road can be hard, but when we remember why we're doing it, it keeps us going" (in Calvin's words) [S4T25][S4T26][S4T27][S4T28].
- On 2023-05-03, reconnected with Calvin ("long time no talk") and announced the team-up with the local garage; Calvin congratulated him on "this new venture", called it "super inspiring" and "impressive how far [Dave has] come since [they] last chatted", asked about his plans for next, and encouraged him not to forget to relax and enjoy the process; the two also swapped how they unwind — Calvin: long drives in his red sports car (details in ## Car maintenance shop, ## Classic cars, and /memories/calvin.md) [S5T1][S5T2][S5T3][S5T4][S5T6][S5T7][S5T8].

- On 2023-10-23, caught up with Calvin, picking back up a chat they'd had "the other day" about fame and its impact on relationships (a chat not otherwise recorded in this memory): asked how the tour with Frank Ocean is going — "It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too" — and how Calvin juggles his job plus his personal life; Calvin: the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd energizes him — but fame has its own challenges and balancing everything is tough [S25T1][S25T2]. Dave asked how he manages and whether he ever feels overwhelmed; Calvin: he takes it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands — still, he enjoys what he does so he pushes on [S25T3][S25T4]. Dave asked for strategies that help Calvin manage everything; Calvin: having a strong support system is really helpful — his friends and team keep him on track — and Dave agreed that having people who understand and support you is really important [S25T5][S25T6]. Dave then told Calvin he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own — and that interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed, and asked Calvin how he stays informed; Calvin: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired (Calvin's side in the 2023-10-23 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T7][S25T8]. The conversation then turned to art: Dave said "Art is amazing how it reflects the world" and asked whether anything had caught Calvin's eye lately and made an impact on his music; Calvin: yes — recently he's been really inspired by the struggles that people go through, and it's made him dig deeper into his music to try to capture those feelings [S25T9][S25T10]. Dave asked whether using his music to share experiences and feelings is cathartic for him; Calvin: it's a way for him to express himself and work through his emotions — "like my own form of therapy" (Calvin's details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T11][S25T12]. Dave said he gets it — cars give him an outlet to express himself, "like a little oasis of calm," and working on one is "like I'm connecting back with myself" — and that the music helps too; he shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place"; details in ## Car maintenance shop) [S25T13]. Calvin: "Looking cool — what made you start working on cars?"; Dave: ever since he was ten he's been fascinated with how machines work — he found an old car in a neighbor's garage, asked if he could fix it, and that's when his love for car engineering began — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made him hooked, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage; details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T14][S25T15]. Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life." and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is currently working on another project [S25T16]; Dave answered in the continuation of the chat: "Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector" (the 2022 restoration — see ## Classic cars), "Now I'm working on something new, and it's quite a challenge!" — sharing a photo of his new project car (a black car parked in a parking lot — "Take a look at this wonderful car!") [S25T17]. Calvin: "Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?" — Dave: it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off [S25T18][S25T19]. Calvin: details "can really make a difference" and are what makes something great — "like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car" [S25T20]; Dave: paying attention to details "makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles" — little things can make a big impact [S25T21]. Calvin: without those details it's just average, and as an artist he wants to create something extraordinary — sharing a photo of his record (a silver disc in a black frame on a table; Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md) [S25T22]; Dave: he loves the attention to detail in Calvin's work — "it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!" — sharing a photo of his brown amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T23]; Calvin: "Thanks Dave! Appreciate your support!" [S25T24]. The chat then turned to concerts: Dave, glad that Calvin liked his garage, said the good times he's had at concerts last month (~September 2023 — e.g., the Boston rock concert ~2023-09-09/10, see ## Music) remind him that "music has a way of connecting us and making memories" — "Take a look at this picture, the atmosphere was amazing!" (shared a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); Calvin: "Music has a way of bringing us together and creating unforgettable memories. It's unbeatable in terms of the energy it brings." (shared a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); Dave: "Concerts are awesome, they bring people together and create such a cool vibe. You can feel the energy in the air." — sharing another photo from a concert (a crowd of people standing around a stage — "this unforgettable moment that I captured"); Calvin: "Concerts are what I live for - the indescribable connection between the artist and the crowd is just amazing!" — which Dave marveled at ("So glad you get to experience that!") [S25T25][S25T26][S25T27][S25T28][S25T29]; Calvin: "It's a rush connecting with everyone. That feeling is unbeatable! Wishing you a harmonious day ahead, my friend!" [S25T30]; Dave: "I can imagine it's a rush being up on stage with all the fans cheering. Must be a unique experience. Wishing you many more electrifying moments in the spotlight! See you soon!" — the conversation closed [S25T31].

- On 2023-11-17, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin, long time no talk!"): Calvin told him he went to a "fancy gala" in Boston the day before (2023-11-16) and met some interesting people, and shared a pic of himself and "the crew" (a photography of a group of men sitting on a rock next to a river; Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Calvin, that event looks amazing! You all look awesome. Who did you have the most interesting chat with?" (Dave's message also carried a photo of a boat floating in the water at sunset) [S30T1][S30T2][S30T3]. Calvin: he had a really interesting chat with "this cool artist" — they clicked over music and art, talked about favorite artists, art, and "how the power of music connects us all" — "It was such an inspiring conversation - I feel like I'm on a creative high." — and shared a photo of the two of them sitting on a bench in the snow (Calvin's side in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "That's amazing, Calvin! Music really does bring people together and foster creativity. Glad to hear you had such an inspiring conversation!" and shared his new vintage camera that he bought this month (November 2023) (a photo of a camera sitting on a table next to a plant) — "which takes awesome photos!" (details in ## Photography) [S30T4][S30T5]. Calvin: "Hey Dave, music really brings people together, huh? Do you use this camera for photos? They always turn out so good!"; Dave: yes — "this camera is very good, it helps me capture those special moments really clearly" [S30T6][S30T7]. Calvin: "Having a good camera is key for capturing those special moments." and asked what Dave likes to take photos of (Calvin's message closed with a photo of a sunset with a wave crashing on rocks) [S30T8]. The chat then continued: Dave answered — he loves capturing the beauty of nature (sunsets, beaches, waves) and shared a sunset/wave pic; the two agreed nature's beauty conveys emotion and can boost our spirits in tough times (Dave shared a waterfall pic he snapped the previous week at a nearby park — Calvin: "Can't wait to check it out myself sometime" — and Calvin closed that part of the exchange with a pic he shot in a Japanese garden, a bench under a tree with pink flowers) (details in ## Photography and ## Parks; Calvin's side in the Photography, Music, and Relationships sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S30T9][S30T10][S30T11][S30T12][S30T13][S30T14][S30T15][S30T16]. The chat then continued: Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Found an even better spot, with a bench under a tree with pink flowers - so peaceful. A perfect spot to relax and take in the beauty." (he describes the same bench-under-a-pink-flower-tree scene Calvin just photographed as "a spot" he found; details in ## Photography); Calvin: "That sounds great, Dave! Can't wait to see it." [S30T17][S30T18]. Dave: "Check it out, Calvin. It's really calming, I think you'll like it. We will definitely go there!" — and asked whether there was anything else Calvin would like to share [S30T19]. Calvin: yes — a few more great news: he's accepted an invitation to perform at an upcoming show in Boston — "It's going to be an unforgettable musical experience!" — and he'll fill Dave in on all the details later (details in the Music section of this file and in ## Music of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing news! Congratulations on both the gala attendance and the upcoming performance. I can't wait to hear all about it and maybe even catch one of your shows in Boston. Let me know when you're free to catch up. Cheers to your musical journey!" [S30T20][S30T21]. Calvin: "Thanks, Dave! I'll catch you when I'm in Boston. Cheers!" — and the chat closed with goodbyes — Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you. Stay safe, talk to you soon!" and Calvin: "Thanks! You too. Talk to you later!" [S30T22][S30T23][S30T24].

- By 2023-05-01, had finally opened his own car maintenance shop — called it a dream come true; "so satisfying to have a spot to work on cars"; it was a lot of hard work, but it was worth it [S4T1][S4T3].
- Shared a photo of the shop (a car dealership with cars parked in front) [S4T1].
- Opening the shop was his dream and is a step toward his other dream of working on classic cars [S4T3][S4T5].
- Calvin congratulated him, said his hard work and dedication paid off, praised his "guts and ambition", and told him to keep it up [S4T2][S4T4].
- Called opening the shop a "labor of love" — challenging, but "so worth it"; feeling the hard work pay off is "like bringing something back to life" (echoing his car-restoration sentiment), and he finds it incredible that his skills and hard work made it happen [S4T9][S4T11][S4T13].
- Says the "perfect blend of dedication and passion" keeps him motivated and makes it all worthwhile; Calvin encouraged him to "keep going for it!" [S4T14][S4T15][S4T16].
- Shared a second photo of the shop (a group of people standing in front of a car) and invited Calvin to come by sometime [S4T17].
- Works on all kinds of cars at the shop — from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars — which "keeps [him] busy and happy" [S4T18][S4T19].
- Working on cars is what he's passionate about: doing it every day is "so rewarding", "seeing the transformation is awesome", and he finds it satisfying to help people keep their cars in good condition [S4T21].
- Appreciates Calvin's encouragement: "It means a lot that my work is valued and that it brings joy to others" [S4T23].
- On 2023-05-03, announced he is teaming up with a local garage — Calvin called it "this new venture"; the exchange included photos of a car being worked on in a garage (Dave's) and of a green car in a garage with a sign in the background (on Calvin's turn) [S5T1][S5T2].
- "Loving this job" — works with awesome mechanics and shares his knowledge about cars; shared a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage and called the current project cool but a bit challenging [S5T3].
- For now, focused on continuing to work on the current project and assisting customers [S5T5].
- On 2023-05-16, told Calvin the shop had opened the previous week (~2023-05-08/14) and that he had invited friends over to celebrate — "it's been amazing"; he's "super stoked to share [his] passion and help out with folks' rides" and it has "been incredible so far" [S6T8]. Note this conflicts with the 2023-05-01 statement that the shop had already opened (see above); the later date is recorded as stated.
- On 2023-05-16, Calvin congratulated him on opening his own car shop ("Way to go, Dave!" — his excitement is contagious, "keep up the great work"); Dave thanked him, called it "quite a journey so far," and said he's excited to see what the future holds [S6T9][S6T10].
- As of 2023-05-31, had recently fixed a neighbor's car engine himself — the neighbor "had been having some trouble with the engine", which is now done; shared a photo of himself working on the car engine in a garage. (Calvin recognized the car as the one Dave had been fixing the engine of "for a friend.") [S7T2][S7T3].
- On 2023-10-15, told Calvin it's been "a crazy rollercoaster week": a competing car maintenance shop snagged a deal that Dave's shop had been trying to secure for months; he felt "kinda bummed out" and questioned whether his hard work is a waste — "I put in so much effort at work, but it feels like nothing. Am I wasting my time?"; Calvin encouraged him — "don't give up, keep pushing and believe in yourself. The payoff will be worth it." — and Dave said he's "gotta have faith and patience" and is "sure it's only a matter of time till things work out" [S23T1][S23T2][S23T3].
- On 2023-10-23, shared a photo of his garage (a garage with a bunch of tools hanging on the wall — "a little dirty, but everything is in its place") while telling Calvin that working on a car is his own outlet (details in the 2023-10-23 entry of ## Relationships and in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose) [S25T13].
